newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Seven Network sets up Olympic Games unit.
newsitem.headline: Seven Network sets up Olympic Games unit.

text.p: Television broadcaster Seven Network Ltd said on Tuesday it had formed a Olympics Games unit which will responsible for broadcasting the Olympic Games.
Australia's second-ranked television network has the exclusive rights to the 1996, 2000, 2004 and 2008 summer games as well as the 2002 and 2006 winter games.
"Our partnership with the International Olympic Committee represents a significant financial and logistical undertaking for Seven," Seven's managing director Gary Rice said in a statement.
"The long-term agreement also enhances a number of long-term opportunities for the company's involvement in new communication technologies," Rice said.
